answers.q1: Use uv (uv.lock is present; .python-version is 3.11, requires-python >=3.10; do not use pip). Install with: uv sync --locked --extra all
answers.q4: CI runs the pre-commit workflow, which executes: uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure (use master as the base branch for the default case). The local lint and format scripts are: bash scripts/lint.sh (runs mypy fastapi, ty check, ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts, ruff format fastapi tests --check) and bash scripts/format.sh (runs ruff check --fix and ruff format on fastapi tests docs_src scripts).
answers.q5: uv.lock is the generated lockfile and must not be edited by hand (AGENTS.md says so, and it is regenerated by uv). No other generated or vendored directories are marked do-not-edit. Non-English docs under docs/<lang>/ are produced by translation tooling, and the ensure-non-translated pre-commit hook guards them.
